facts.text: The image is a multi-panel photorealistic character reference sheet: a large hero panel sits above three full-body turnaround panels and four detail panels, separated by thin black gutters.
The top panel, labeled HERO, shows the character standing on a wet city street at night in the rain, with metal railings on both sides and warm lights glowing in the background.
In the hero panel the character stands with feet apart, arms hanging at their sides, body toward the camera, and head turned toward the left side of the frame.
The character is an adult with short, close-shaved sides and a longer top section gathered into a small topknot; a scar is visible through one eyebrow.
The character wears a dark high-collared tactical jacket with buckle and strap details, a dark undershirt, black cargo trousers, and black lace-up combat boots.

The middle panels, labeled FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, and BACK, show the same character full-length against a dark gray studio backdrop, facing forward, in profile facing left, and facing away, respectively.
The bottom panels, labeled FACE, JACKET COLLAR, HANDS, and BOOTS, show close-ups of the face, jacket collar hardware, relaxed hands, and laced leather combat boots.
The face close-up shows a neutral, serious expression with sharp facial features and the eyebrow scar clearly visible.

Lighting is low-key and cinematic: the night scene is dominated by cool blue-gray rain and black clothing, with warm amber streetlight and bokeh accents reflected on the wet pavement; the studio panels use soft directional light.
White uppercase labels identify each panel: HERO, FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, BACK, FACE, JACKET COLLAR, HANDS, and BOOTS.

limitations: Static image; motion and temporal context cannot be determined.
Distant background details in the rainy night panel are partly obscured by darkness and rain.
